qualification: Local macOS arm64; disposable stores and loopback MCP/QUIC only. No provider account, public ingress, production database or deployment changed.
status: Registered-origin Vapi MCP admission component qualified; provider lifecycle composition and full Gate 4 acceptance remain open
implemented: One fixed registered provider binding per adapter; current narrow grant authority is authenticated before provider correlation is interpreted. No shared bearer selects tasks from headers.
Exact call and standalone chat admission, plus session-scoped chat admission requiring the registered session ID and a bounded chat ID. A session grant covers chats in that one session.
Local/native or host-session bindings, wrong provider kind, malformed/duplicate/missing/conflicting IDs, owner bearers, cross-task grants and wrong resources are rejected.
The MCP layer has no SQL or provider lookup and cannot register origins, mint grants or promote authority. Existing native/host server configuration still rejects provider origins.
